prompts.shapes: Extend the provided modular Japanese anime medieval RPG portrait library, same thin warm brown outlines and soft restrained cel-shading. References 1 existing assembled characters, 2 male blank face template, 3 female blank face template. Production spritesheet of isolated transparent cutouts, EVEN GRID 4 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS, generous gutters, no labels. ROW 1: cell1 blank MALE face with clearly SQUARE CHIN and angular lower jaw, same compact forehead, temples, ear positions and height as template; cell2 blank MALE CHUBBY FACE with rounded cheeks and softer fuller lower jaw, same forehead/temple width and height, not a giant head; cell3 blank FEMALE face with square chin and subtle angular lower jaw, same feminine adult template proportions; cell4 blank FEMALE chubby face, round full cheeks but same forehead/temple width and height. All four faces are SKIN AND EARS ONLY, NO eyes eyebrows nose mouth hair or neck, warm matching skin. ROW 2: cell1 MALE dark muted teal lower-face cloth scarf mask, front-facing wrapped cloth covers nose/mouth/chin only, upper edge fits bridge BELOW eyes, completely independent cloth no head skin eyes hair neck or body; cell2 FEMALE muted rust lower-face scarf mask with same construction and feminine size, cloth only; cell3 MALE dark burgundy BANDANA HEAD WRAP with low fitted crown, folds and small tied knot at side, headwear ONLY no face/skin/hair; cell4 FEMALE muted indigo headscarf bandana, fitted low crown and small side knot, headwear only no face skin hair. ROW 3: cell1 MALE SILVER WHITE short wavy swept-back HAIR ONLY overlay with transparent face opening, no skin/ears/head; cell2 FEMALE SILVER WHITE short soft wavy hair overlay with transparent face opening, no skin ears head, no long hair under jaw; cells3/4 EMPTY. Keep hairline natural and not too high; bandanas must leave the eye line completely uncovered. Genuine alpha transparent background including all holes. Do not merge any parts or draw assembled faces.
prompts.male-expressions: Create a modular MALE facial-expression and aging spritesheet extending the provided Japanese anime medieval RPG library, identical warm thin brown linework and restrained cel-shading, realistic adult compact face proportions within the anime style. Genuine transparent alpha background. EVEN GRID FOUR COLUMNS x THREE ROWS with generous empty gutters. All objects isolated, no labels, no assembled face. ROW1: cell1 ONE PAIR aged male eyes with gently drooping eyelids and bushy gray-white eyebrows, kind older gaze, no surrounding skin patches; cell2 ONE PAIR closed crescent laughing male eyes with relaxed eyebrows; cell3 ONE PAIR angry male eyes with visibly inward/downward slanted brows, pupils forward; cell4 ONE PAIR menacing male eyes, narrowed gaze, one brow subtly arched, no supernatural glowing effects. Eyes and eyebrows are together in each pair, left and right kept at exactly same spacing as reference, no extra eyes. ROW2: cell1 ONE male open laughing MOUTH, small natural smile with visible upper teeth and warm dark mouth interior, no surrounding face; cell2 ONE male angry MOUTH, tense pressed lips with very small teeth clench, restrained; cell3 ONE male menacing MOUTH, thin asymmetric smirk; cell4 EMPTY. ROW3: cell1 FOREHEAD WRINKLES ONLY overlay: three subtle warm-brown gently curved horizontal broken creases, linework and tiny soft shadows, absolutely NO forehead skin plate; cell2 MOUTH AGE FOLDS ONLY overlay: left and right nasolabial creases and tiny corners of mouth creases, open transparent center for the independent mouth, no mouth or skin plate; cell3 EYE CROW'S FEET WRINKLES ONLY overlay: small groups of subtle creases at left and right outer eye corners, open transparent center, NO eyes brows face or skin plate; cell4 EMPTY. Wrinkles should be visible yet understated and pleasant, not scars, facial wounds or thick black lines. Every cutout independent with genuine transparency, no faces heads hair neck or background.
